# Synthetic Media Fixtures

Generated by `scripts/generate_synthetic_fixtures.py`.

All files are **minimal format stubs** — they carry valid magic bytes (or deferred
format-detection for AAC/WMA) so they pass `validate_media_signature()`, but they
hold no real audio content and cannot be transcribed by Whisper or FFmpeg.

Re-generate at any time:

```
python scripts/generate_synthetic_fixtures.py
```

## Files

| File | Format | Detection method | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `synthetic_meeting.mp4` | MP4 | `ftyp` box (brand: `isom`) | MP4 upload-path tests |
| `synthetic_voicememo.m4a` | M4A | `ftyp` box (brand: `M4A `) | M4A upload-path tests |
| `synthetic_interview.mp3` | MP3 | ID3v2 header (`ID3`) | MP3 upload-path tests |
| `synthetic_conference.wav` | WAV | `RIFF`/`WAVE` headers (100 ms silence) | WAV upload-path tests |
| `synthetic_podcast.flac` | FLAC | `fLaC` stream marker | FLAC upload-path tests |
| `synthetic_recording.ogg` | OGG | `OggS` capture pattern | OGG upload-path tests |
| `synthetic_audio.aac` | AAC | ADTS sync word (FFprobe deferred) | AAC format-routing tests |
| `synthetic_audio.wma` | WMA | ASF header GUID (FFprobe deferred) | WMA format-routing tests |

## Claim boundary

These files exist to test format detection and API routing. They do not
represent real audio content. No transcription accuracy claim may reference them.
See `tests/eval/synthetic_fixtures.py` for the transcript accuracy evaluation dataset.
